text:
Elliot Park: Morning! First-day quick question — I followed the Console quickstart but when I click into Redwood Console (prod) I get a blank page and the network tab shows a 403 on /api/flags.
Elliot Park: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags returns {"error":"forbidden","message":"role_missing"}. Do new hires get a service account or a role?
Riley (Infra): Welcome Elliot :wave: New hires get a JIT console role (console-read) first. Service accounts are for CI only. Drop your SSO email and I can submit the JIT.
Elliot Park: elliot.park@redwood.ai
Access Bot: Access request created: ONB-7762 by Riley (Infra). Approvers: eng-leads, infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-7762
Riley (Infra): Approving now. Also, prod has some maintenance endpoints behind an IP allowlist; if youre on a home ISP that sometimes causes specific API keys to 403 even after role grant.
Maya (DevEx): If you need to demo flag flips during your intro, I can spin up a temp role with flags:write for 30 minutes. DM me the flag key.
Elliot Park: JIT approved, UI still blank for me. Ran `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 2>&1 | grep x-request-id` and got x-request-id: rq_7f3c1b.
Riley (Infra): Thanks. Trying a quick allowlist for your IP. If that doesnt work you can also use the bastion tunnel: `ssh -NL 8443:console.internal:443 riley@bastion` then open https://localhost:8443.
Elliot Park: Tunnel worked, I can see staging + prod flags now. Thanks!
Sam (Security): Reminder: if you later request a service account include justification + expiry (we prefer 30/90 days). Read-only SAs with a 90-day expiry are auto-approved.
Elliot Park: Filing a follow-up to request a short-lived SA for my demo CI job. Appreciate the quick help everyone :thumbsup:
